semanticBindings.sourceMeaning: Custom battle object rendering, priority and SNES tile/palette/DMA allocation.
semanticBindings.platformAdaptation: Active m3sprites consumer uses priority0. The native scanline compositor reads normalized sprite frames directly and overlays enemy OBJ while BG3 text retains higher priority. General Bowspr priorities1..3, sorting, VRAM/DMA thresholds and palette allocation are not ported APIs because the active consumer does not need them.

semanticBindings.sourceMeaning: Reset/rebuild Bowspr allocation during Giygas scenes, Poo return, temporary-party changes, and defer teddy reward updates.
semanticBindings.platformAdaptation: The direct PC compositor has no shared SNES Bowspr entity/VRAM allocation to end or rebuild; it reads current battlers, character mode and controlled-party count each frame. Native inventory still performs teddy updates immediately, so the source deferral is not literally reproduced.

semanticBindings.sourceMeaning: Title letter movement, timed reveal, glowing Mother/2 palettes and no transient blank/reload on A.
semanticBindings.platformAdaptation: Eleven Script788..798 movement pointers and full relocated regions are regenerated and matched to the native pack; typed palette-copy call becomes explicit native BF000D, and var3 selects the separate gradient buffer.
unverifiedLiveBranches: Exact title frame/pixel alignment and glow cadence versus source.

semanticBindings.sourceMeaning: Optimized VWF blit and character width/padding handling.
semanticBindings.platformAdaptation: The native renderer performs glyph masking, row/bitplane writes, tile-boundary clearing, and width+padding advances in C. It does not reproduce 65816 cycle optimizations. Five fonts with128 glyphs each are regenerated and byte-matched to the native pack.
unverifiedLiveBranches: All glyphs/fonts at every pixel offset, wide-glyph strip and tile-boundary pixel comparison.

semanticBindings.sourceMeaning: Leader-aware sidecar sprites, follower hiding, faster bike speeds, post-battle/death/revive/mushroom refresh.
semanticBindings.platformAdaptation: Native leader slots24..27 and sidecar groups477..480 replace assembly entity offsets. Hiding uses native DRAW_DISABLED; explicit refresh rebuilds status-aware party entities. Single-party Ness bike7 behavior is also in the active source.
unverifiedLiveBranches: All temporary-party compositions, sectors/doors/indoor dismounts and post-battle audio/story combinations.

semanticBindings.sourceMeaning: MSU music request/stop/fades with SPC fallback and source loop policy.
semanticBindings.platformAdaptation: SDL PCM mixing replaces SNES MSU registers and NMI. Source256-track repeat flags match exactly. Native fades are continuous audio-sample ramps: fast240/255 per second, slow120/255, quarter/full180/255; source uses per-NMI integer steps and cutoff thresholds. Audible fade duration can differ slightly; bit-exact NMI envelope parity is not claimed.
unverifiedLiveBranches: Listening to every soundtrack and sound effect.
Every story/bicycle/boss transition and extended IDs192..255 playback.
